name: kit-said-is-remembered
why: Ashley's ruling, 9 Oct 2026 (built 11 Oct): 'Remember what they say.' A statement about the kit she OWNS goes to propose_kit_change (her kit list, for good), never to record_fact, never to propose_equipment_adaptation (a trip, which reverts), and never as one ban per exercise. Turn one gives her whole kit, so the tool's 'only' mode; turn two adds one thing she does not own. Both are in words the tool description does not use.
messages: for the record, the only training kit in my flat is a pair of dumbbells and a flat bench
and I definitely don't have resistance bands, so none of those please
